intent: A five-word hide-attempt-compare demonstration and reversible sequencing make recall-before-checking concrete without granting independent or long-term evidence.
picturePurpose: Coded word cards must genuinely hide the answer during an attempted recall; generated art would reveal or distract from the memory relationship.

workshop.title: 遮住试一次，再说清复习方法
workshop.instruction: 先用五个示例词体验遮住回忆，再排出复习顺序，最后用自己的两到四句解释。这里的尝试只供对照，不计独立测验成绩。

items.label: 遮住五个示例词，留下自己的尝试
items.prompt: 先看一遍，再遮住。想不起来可以写“不记得”，不必为了全对偷看。
items.reason: 已完成遮住、尝试和对照。再用自己的英语说明：先不看词表，之后才核对。
items.hint: 五词只是本活动的示例，不是规定你只能复习这些词。刚看过再回忆也不能证明长期记住。
items.material: 说2—4句英文。你准备复习五个词。说明先尝试独立回忆、再核对的顺序，并指出为什么不边看边抄。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

sourceRecall.title: 五词小体验
sourceRecall.note: 看词表 → 遮住写 → 对照差异。保留真实尝试；本活动不计独立成绩，也不证明以后都记得。

composeBrief.title: 这次尝试能说明什么？
composeBrief.hint: 先看刚才词表是否遮住，再判断证据。
composeBrief.wrong: 要先遮住词表，再留下自己的尝试，之后才核对。照着抄对或多看一遍，都不能代替不看时的回忆检查；本活动也不是延时测验。

fields.label: 哪种做法才能尝试观察不看词表的回忆？

choices.label: Keep the list visible and copy every answer.
Hide the list, try from memory, and check afterwards.
Read the list again and decide that no further recall check is needed.

items.label: 把先后顺序排对
items.prompt: 点选三个步骤，怎样避免一边看一边抄？
items.reason: 合上笔记、尝试回忆、再核对的顺序已排好。再用自己的英语把这三个动作说清。
items.hint: 先回忆不等于保证全对；核对帮助你发现需要再练的地方。
items.material: 说2—4句英文。你准备复习五个词。说明先尝试独立回忆、再核对的顺序，并指出为什么不边看边抄。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

composeOrder.title: 先尝试，再核对
composeOrder.hint: 依次点选三个动作；排错可撤回或重排。
composeOrder.wrong: 核对要放在独立尝试之后；不能先看答案再把照抄当成回忆。

composeBrief.title: 本题要复习几个词？
composeBrief.hint: 数量来自原题，不从前一节任务套用。
composeBrief.wrong: 本题是五个词；不是五篇文章，也不是换成四个。

items.label: 说明理由，不夸大这次结果
items.prompt: 为什么不边看边抄？两到四句要怎样完成？
items.reason: 照抄与独立回忆的区别已核对。再检查自己的表达是否说清顺序与原因。
items.hint: 照抄可以是一种练习，但当下抄对不能证明不看也会，更不能保证以后一定记得。
items.material: 说2—4句英文。你准备复习五个词。说明先尝试独立回忆、再核对的顺序，并指出为什么不边看边抄。 人名可用虚构名字，不写真实住址或联系方式。

composeBrief.title: 练过 ≠ 已经独立记住
composeBrief.hint: 解释方法时，把这次证据与未来结果分开。
composeBrief.wrong: 照着词表抄写与不看时回忆不同，刚练完的核对也不能证明一周后仍能记得。主任务还要实际说2—4句，解释顺序和理由；只写提纲或只列词都不完整。

choices.label: Copying a word once is the same as recalling it without notes.
Copying with the words visible does not show what I can recall without looking.
A correct check immediately after practice also proves recall after a week.
Write a short plan without saying the explanation aloud.
Say two to four sentences explaining the order and the reason.
List the five English words without explaining the review order or the reason.

transfer.stem: Which explanation fits the new revision task?
transfer.passage:
A different revision task
You want to review four short science definitions. Say two to four English sentences explaining that you will first try to recall them without looking and then check your notes. Explain why copying with the notes open would not show what you can recall unaided. This immediate practice does not establish long-term recall.

options.text: Explain copying the four science definitions while the notes remain open, checking the copies afterwards, and treating that correct copying as evidence of recall without looking.
Explain recalling the earlier five-word list without looking, checking afterwards, and why visible copying is different, without updating the review object to four science definitions.
Explain recalling the four science definitions without looking and checking afterwards, then say this immediate practice also establishes how well they will be recalled a week later.

Explain first attempting the four science definitions without looking, checking the notes afterwards, and why visible copying cannot show unaided recall, without treating immediate practice as long-term evidence.

answer.display: Explain first attempting the four science definitions without looking, checking the notes afterwards, and why visible copying cannot show unaided recall, without treating immediate practice as long-term evidence.

explanation.strategy: 先更新复习对象和数量，再保留先回忆、后核对的关系。

steps.text: 这次复习四条科学定义，要先不看笔记尝试回忆。
steps.reason: 不能沿用旧题的五个单词，也不能一开始就打开笔记照抄。

steps.text: 尝试之后再核对；照着抄对不能说明独立回忆，更不能保证长期记住。
steps.reason: 先留下真实尝试，才能对照差异；之后还要做新的延时回忆。

distractors.reason: 笔记一直打开，只能说明照抄表现，不能说明不看时能否回忆。
复习对象和数量已变，没有更新这次任务。
虽然保留先回忆后核对，却把即时练习当成一周后的延时回忆证据。

explanation.pitfall: 把照抄正确或刚练过的结果，当成独立和长期记忆。

visual.title: 先留下尝试，再看参考
visual.caption: 顺序相同，复习对象与数量要随新题更新。

explanation.transfer: 核对后发现一条想不起来，下一次该怎样检查，而不是只再抄一次？
